'''Jacc Mandelbrot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who operated the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

==Biography==
Jacc Mandelbrot started his career by working in the textile industry in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Using the money he earned, Mandelbrot put himself through university and then went on to found several business while in his early twenties. Each business was sold for a large profit. While on a business trip to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] with a client, Mandelbrot decided to move there and sold all his holdings in the Kathol sector. Buying a small bar and gambling establishment known as [[Lucky's Tavern]], Mandelbrot purchased the office space next door and remodeled the place. A month later, the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] opened.<ref name="GG2-2" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Mandelbrot was in his forties and had owned the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] for a number of decades. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Mandelbrot hired a group of undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents to provide security at the casino during the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]].<ref name="QAD">{{DoD|The Queen of Air and Darkness}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mandelbrot was in his fifties. Over the years, he had brought on silent partners to clear business obstacles or create peace with various criminal and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] interests. [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] also held a stake in the establishment.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
*Jacc Mandelbrot was identified as both "Jacc Maldelbrot" and "Jacc Mandelbrot" in the [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|second edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''. ''[[The Queen of Air and Darkness]]'' used the latter spelling exclusively. This article assumes that the latter spelling is the correct one.
